correctness.rationale: The three published \(R\)-generators are reconstructed over \(\mathbb F_4\); seven cyclic shifts of each give rank \(14\). Conjugating the ordinary nullspace gives a rank-\(7\) Hermitian-dual basis because \(M\overline y^{\mathsf T}=0\) is exactly the Hermitian orthogonality condition. Exhaustive enumeration of all \(4^7\) dual words gives the stated complete spectrum and minimum distance \(11\). The Hermitian Gram matrix has rank \(6\), giving hull dimension \(1\), and direct support/orbit enumeration gives \(119\) minimum supports in \(17\) seven-cycles with the stated block patterns.

An exact complete spectrum quantifies all weight layers, while the one-dimensional Hermitian hull is a structural invariant relevant to LCD/hull-based applications. The 119 minimum supports and their 17 QC-shift orbits give a compact incidence description of the minimum layer, and the block-pattern census records how those optimal-distance supports are distributed across the three QC components.
